entities.name: 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Provides mutual authentication between UE and network and agrees on keys KAUSF, KSEAF, and KAMF. Initiated and controlled by the network.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate 5G AKA authentication procedure. Does not contain EAP message IE.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier included in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: ABBA
entities.description: ABBA parameter included in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: KAUSF
entities.description: Authentication Server Function key computed during 5G AKA procedure.

entities.name: KSEAF
entities.description: Security Anchor Function key computed during 5G AKA procedure.

entities.name: KAMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function key stored in 5G NAS security contexts. Root for 5GS integrity protection and ciphering key hierarchy.

entities.name: CK and IK
entities.description: Cipher Key and Integrity Key computed by USIM and used as key material to compute KAUSF, KSEAF, and KAMF.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context established in UE and network when 5G authentication is successfully performed.

entities.name: USIM present condition
entities.description: UE shall proceed with 5G authentication challenge only if a USIM is present.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF after successful 5G AKA authentication to take new partial native 5G NAS security context into use.

relations.description: 5G AKA procedure is initiated by AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message includes ngKSI IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message includes ABBA IE.
CK and IK are used as key material to compute KAUSF.
CK and IK are used as key material to compute KSEAF.
CK and IK are used as key material to compute KAMF.
Successful 5G AKA procedure establishes partial native 5G NAS security context.
UE proceeds with 5G authentication challenge only if USIM is present.
AMF initiates security mode control procedure after successful 5G AKA authentication.
